title: Add adjustable luminance grain return to AI raw denoise
source: rapidroom (adapted MIT AutoShade post-demosaic neutral luminance residual return)
notes: Best/Fast Strength defaults to 71 and returns the source luminance residual along RGB grey after demosaic, colour restoration and the complete model chain. Strength 100 preserves the full-clean endpoint. Preview and saved editable DNGs share the result; sensor and queue caches include strength. TreeNet inputs and models are unchanged; no AutoShade weights, telemetry or variance-stabilized input transform are imported. The default requires human quality review and is not a Lightroom-equivalence claim.
